jobDescription:
Job Description Job Title: Executive – Marketing Department: Marketing Location: Gurgaon About the Team: The Marketing team is responsible for driving brand awareness, demand generation, digital campaigns, partner marketing, and go-to-market initiatives across business units. The team collaborates closely with sales, OEM partners, agencies, and internal stakeholders to execute impactful marketing programs that generate business growth and strengthen Redington's market presence. Key Purpose of the Job: The Executive – Marketing will be responsible for supporting end-to-end marketing operations, campaign execution, vendor coordination, marketing communications, reporting, and stakeholder management. The role focuses on ensuring seamless execution of marketing initiatives, maintaining operational efficiency, and supporting demand generation activities. Who We're Looking For: We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented marketing professional with strong coordination, communication, and analytical skills. The ideal candidate should have exposure to marketing operations, campaign execution, digital marketing support, vendor coordination, and reporting. Your

ROLE:
Marketing Operations & Campaign Execution: Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels. Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, OEM partners, and vendors for campaign execution. Ensure timely delivery of marketing assets, creatives, and promotional materials. Digital Marketing & Lead Management: Support digital campaigns across email, social media, paid marketing, and web platforms. Track campaign performance and assist in lead management activities. Coordinate with sales teams to ensure smooth lead handover and campaign follow-up. Reporting & MIS: Prepare marketing MIS reports, campaign dashboards, and performance trackers. Analyze campaign data and provide insights to improve marketing effectiveness. Maintain accurate records of campaign performance, budgets, and marketing activities. Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and partners for marketing activities. Support purchase orders, invoice processing, and marketing documentation. Work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Finance, Legal, and Procurement. Process & Compliance: Ensure adherence to internal marketing processes and approval workflows. Maintain marketing documentation, vendor records, and campaign assets. Support budget tracking and ensure timely closure of operational activities. You're the Right Fit If You: Have experience in marketing operations, campaign coordination, or digital marketing. Possess strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Have working knowledge of MS Excel, Power Point, and digital marketing tools. Understand marketing campaign execution and reporting processes. Can manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Have a strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. Are eager to learn and contribute to business growth initiatives. Core Competencies: Marketing operations Campaign execution Digital marketing support MIS reporting and analytics Vendor and stakeholder management Budget and process coordination Cross-functional collaboration Behavioral Skills: Strong communication skills Analytical thinking Attention to detail Ownership and accountability Team collaboration Time management and multitasking Adaptability and learning agility Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field. Relevant experience in marketing operations, campaign management, digital marketing, or marketing coordination is preferred. Today, we are a $11.8 billion organization with strong foundations in distribution, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. We are evolving from a successful legacy business into a next-generation technology enablement powerhouse—unlocking new revenue streams, transforming our operating model, and building an enterprise that is more digital, more agile, and future-ready. title: Lead Consultant - FICO
jobDescription:
Job Description About the team: The SAP is responsible for managing and maintaining the SAP system landscape for Redington, along with delivering project-based solutions. The team supports core SAP modules including FI/CO, SD, and MM, and manages integrations with external systems such as Mule Soft and Success Factors. The team plays a key role in ensuring stable operations, system enhancements, and seamless business process integration across functions. Who we’re looking for: We are looking for a skilled Associate Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ABAP and related technologies. The ideal candidate should be capable of designing, developing, and supporting SAP-based solutions while ensuring effective integration across business applications and maintaining high-quality delivery standards. Your

ROLE:
• SAP Solution Delivery: Contribute to and execute the SAP platform roadmap in collaboration with business stakeholders, ensuring prioritization of requirements and effective delivery of projects and enhancements. • Process & Solution Design: Design, develop, and implement robust SAP solutions for Operations, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise applications. • ABAP Development: Strong hands-on experience in ABAP development including UI5, Dialog Programming, Data Migration, Enhancements, Forms, and ABAP Objects (RICEFW). • Technical Expertise: Experience in Smart Forms, API development, RFC development, User Exits, BADIs, and BAPIs. • Data & Quality Management: Ensure data consistency and availability while adhering to coding standards and achieving First Time Right (FTR) and On-Time Completion (OTC) objectives. • Tools & Processes: Work with IT tools and ticketing systems such as Redserve, JIRA, and Service Now, ensuring adherence to internal processes and standards. • Requirement Analysis: Collaborate with functional and business teams to gather requirements and deliver technical specifications, system designs, and test documentation. • Testing & QA: Define test plans, conduct unit/system testing, and ensure adherence to change management and quality assurance processes. • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of system changes, enhancements, bug fixes, and ensure alignment with governance standards. • Continuous Improvement: Support continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing SAP processes, integrations, and system performance. You’re the right fit if:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred). Experience: • Strong experience in SAP ABAP development and SAP technical modules • Hands-on exposure to SAP integrations and enterprise application support • Experience in IT/ERP environments, preferably SAP ECC or S/4HANA Core Competencies: • Strong SAP ABAP development skills (RICEFW objects) • Knowledge of SAP integration techniques and development standards • Experience with APIs, RFCs, BAPIs, and enhancements • Understanding of SAP business processes and system architecture • Experience with ticketing and project tools (JIRA, Service Now, etc.) Behavioral Skills: • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills • Good communication and stakeholder management • Ownership-driven and result-oriented mindset • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under deadlines • Strong collaboration with functional and technical teams About Redington: Redington is one of the largest technology solutions orchestrators across India, the Middle East, and Africa. With a presence in distribution, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies, we are a $11.8 billion organization building a next-generation, digital-first enterprise. We are transforming from a legacy distribution business into a future-ready technology enablement powerhouse, driven by innovation, strong partnerships, and scalable digital platforms. Redington is known for: • Deep and extensive distribution network • Strong presence in high-growth emerging markets • Broad ecosystem of global technology partnerships If you are interested in this role and meet many, but not all, of the criteria, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right fit for this or other opportunities at Redington. Learn more at https://redingtongroup.com . title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobDescription:
Job Description Job Description Job Title: Internal Auditor About the Team: The Internal Audit team at Redington plays a key role in evaluating and strengthening the organization’s internal control framework across functions and geographies. The team works closely with business and functional stakeholders to ensure compliance, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency through a structured, risk-based audit approach. Key Purpose of the Job: As part of the Internal Audit team, you will execute internal audits across geographies, functions, and processes under the supervision of the Internal Audit Head. The role involves evaluating the adequacy of internal controls, assessing alignment of processes with business objectives, and identifying opportunities for operational improvements through a risk-based audit approach. You will be responsible for conducting process walkthroughs and testing the design and effectiveness of controls. Who We’re Looking For: We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical audit professional with strong understanding of auditing principles and methodologies. The ideal candidate should be able to work in a dynamic environment, manage multiple audits, and effectively engage with stakeholders to validate findings and ensure timely closure of audit observations. Your

ROLE:
Adhere to the internal audit methodology to ensure consistency in audit execution Develop risk control matrices and testing strategies in consultation with the Manager Perform process risk assessments, walkthroughs, and control testing within defined timelines Analyse data to identify impact and value at risk for audit observations Validate audit issues with process owners and ensure factual accuracy Maintain audit documentation as per internal audit standards and methodology Support peers and contribute to broader internal audit initiatives Communicate audit status periodically and escalate challenges and findings to the Manager Follow up with stakeholders for timely closure of open audit observations You’re the Right Fit If You: Are a Qualified Chartered Accountant (preferred) Have experience in risk-based internal audits in Big 4 firms, reputed audit firms, or MNCs Understand audit processes such as walkthroughs, testing procedures, and control evaluation Have strong ability to identify issues, assess impact, and determine root causes Can work independently with minimal supervision Have strong communication and audit documentation skills Are comfortable handling large data sets and have good Excel/analytical skills (added advantage) Have basic knowledge of SAP and IT general/application controls (preferred) Are a quick learner with an agile mindset Are willing to travel up to 20–30% (primarily within India) Core Competencies: Risk-based internal audit execution Internal control evaluation Data analysis and risk assessment Audit documentation and reporting Stakeholder coordination and issue validation Behavioral Skills: Analytical thinking Attention to detail Strong accountability Proactive approach Effective communication Ability to work under minimal supervision Job Snapshot Updated Date 17/07/2026 Job ID Job_22 Department Internal Audit Location Corporate Office, Tamil Nadu, India Experience 0

Job Description Product Manager About the Team The Product Management team is responsible for driving business growth, profitability, and market expansion across assigned technology portfolios. Working closely with global technology vendors, sales teams, and channel partners, the team develops go-to-market strategies, enables partner success, and ensures sustainable business growth through effective product lifecycle and portfolio management. Who We're Looking For We are looking for a commercially driven Product Manager who can own the growth and profitability of an assigned product portfolio. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with relationship management skills and is passionate about driving revenue through strategic vendor partnerships, channel engagement, and sales enablement initiatives. Your Role As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for delivering revenue and profitability targets for your assigned product portfolio. You will manage vendor relationships, collaborate with sales teams to strengthen the sales pipeline, drive channel partner engagement, and ensure successful execution of marketing and enablement initiatives. You will also act as the primary escalation point for product-related business issues. Key Responsibilities Drive quarterly and annual revenue targets for the assigned product portfolio through effective sales pipeline management. Achieve profitability goals by optimizing pricing, margins, and business opportunities. Build and manage strong relationships with technology vendors, including vendor sales teams, distribution managers, and category managers. Collaborate with sales teams to engage key channel partners and drive partner enablement and business development initiatives. Monitor sales funnel performance, including pipeline generation, conversion rates, and business opportunities. Support pricing discussions, bid finalization, and margin realization for business opportunities. Ensure effective execution of product marketing initiatives and channel enablement programs. Act as the primary point of contact for resolving escalated product-related business issues. You're the Right Fit If You have experience managing technology products, vendor relationships, or business portfolios. You possess strong commercial and financial acumen with a focus on revenue and profitability. You are skilled at building relationships with vendors, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders. You are comfortable working with sales teams to drive pipeline growth and business expansion. You enjoy working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and can effectively manage multiple priorities.
